not_fixed.why: Not closable from proprio.py or any K-LEAK file: idle/standby/walk power includes hold_per_kg x the exact held mass (kernel/body.py activity_power_w, _idle_drain). Any monotone readout of the true charge times the drain exactly (one gauge interval gives the power to ~1 s / 1 h), and the exact charge-to-full event ('charging' flag) measures the charge, so quantising runtime_min_est (the review's second suggestion) only slows the attack ~2.5x; it would also break test_body_model's pinned estimates. requests.request: Give every agent episode a secret nonce: task['episode_nonce'] = house_sim.kernel.realism.new_nonce() after build/apply_phrasing and before HouseEnv; keep it out of public logs (dev/train: in the episode log for replay_log; test split: private log only) and re-inject it in replay_log and leaderboard.replay_episode; ScriptedOracle.prepare must build its shadow env with the same nonce. Note: handles now resolve only when issued in the episode, so a ScriptedOracle command naming a thing the harness episode never showed (one the shadow's to_handles issued) is refused there (it is counted in info['divergences']).

Variants are no longer seed % n: _select must compute a candidate's variant with house_sim.tasks.spec.variant_index(catalog_id, seed, n); _variant_phrasings(expanded, index) must use spec.select_variant(expanded, index) (choose_variant now takes a seed); train_seeds' docstring ('seed % len(variants) cycles') -> blocks of n consecutive seeds still hold every variant once; the tests asserting variants == [s % n ...] (test_eval_splits lines ~267, ~345) should use variant_index. The hashed rule is what makes the variant unpredictable on the hidden seeds (review H5).
